reviewType: Independent editorial and source QA of the actual 40-question rebuild, not the obsolete 240-question pack.
difficulty: Editorial targets80/60/40/25/15 percent only; no player success-rate measurement.
method: Read precise MaqamWorld teaching pages, official artist/cultural-institution biographies, institutional archival material, and publisher or licensed release catalogues. Indexed source extracts counted as such, not as a successful full-page fetch. No lyrics reproduced.
